map.：EPS = (10000000−0)/5000000 = 2 元/股。即每股收: : EPS = (10000000 - 0)/5000000 = 2 yuan/share. That is 2 yuan earnings per share.
map.净利润 3 亿元、优先股股利 0 元、股本 1 亿股: Net profit 300 million, preferred dividends 0, share capital 100 million shares
map.：EPS=(300000000−0)/100000000=3.00 元/股，即每: : EPS = (300000000 - 0)/100000000 = 3.00 yuan/share, i.e., each share corresponds to 3 yuan annual profit. If preferred stock exists, deduct preferred dividends from net profit first, then divide by common share capital.
map.优先股股利优先分走，归母普通股东的利润要扣除优先股部分再除以流通普通股数。: Preferred dividends are paid first; profit attributable to common shareholders is net profit minus preferred dividends, divided by shares outstanding.

map.基本 EPS 用期末实际流通股本；稀释 EPS 额外假设可转债、期权、权证全部转: Basic EPS uses actual shares outstanding at period end; diluted EPS additionally assumes convertibles, options and warrants all convert to common stock, enlarging the denominator and lowering the value. For conservative valuation use diluted EPS.
